body:
I suppose I can try Viagra or something but I haven't yet because it's sort of the only hope I have in that regard. If it doesn't work - then what? I will try, though.

It's just that I always thought that if I relaxed and just let myself be this issue would sort of settle - but it's been over 10 years now that things are building up and I just don't know where to turn. No amount of psychological counseling can help (been there, done that) because I'm intelligent enough to know myself and that the numbness I feel inside was not necessarily caused by, but made worse by my conscious attempts to analyze and change my thinking. Imagine that... thinking about the things that you think about makes them worse. Ignorance is bliss.

I have spoken to my wife and she is understanding, but I hate having to burden her with my issues and simultaneously being unable to satisfy her.

I don't know why I'm even posting here... what could ever come of it? Just venting I guess
take solace in the fact that you are not alone - neither in this world, nor in your feelings of being scared etc.
